Marta (Finance): Heads up — Partner payout shortfall flagged by reseller 'HarborEdge'. Their statement shows rebate lines duplicated for March, reducing their commission.
Dee (Billing Ops): Can you paste the snippet?
Marta (Finance): Snippet from partner statement: 
```
line 5: RWINF-PLUS qty 15 $5,250
line 6: HARBOR_REBATE_2028_03 -$525
line 7: HARBOR_REBATE_2028_03 -$525
line 8: partner_commission 18% -$855
```
azure-billing-bot: Marketplace manifest deploy 2028-03-20T02:14:12Z.
Noah (Partner Success): HarborEdge opened a ticket — they want corrected payout ASAP. They said their portal shows only one rebate line.
Dee (Billing Ops): Likely transform rule duplicated when rebate aggregation and export transform both applied the same promo. I'll run a quick ledger-diff.
Ken (Revenue): Exposure estimate? Need to know if provisional payout allowed.
Marta (Finance): Quick scan -> 7 resellers impacted, total partner delta $4,350. HarborEdge $1,050. All under auto-approve $5k.
Dee (Billing Ops): Plan: 1) rollback the duplicate transform change; 2) regen partner statements for affected resellers; 3) issue credit memos + immediate payouts for amounts < $5k. I'll upload CSV.
Noah (Partner Success): I'll ask HarborEdge to sign the quick-ack form for provisional payout.
Marta (Finance): Approve credits <= $5k. Please drop sheet link and I'll prepare memos.
Dee (Billing Ops): Uploaded CSV: https://redwood.app/sheets/azure-rebate-2028 sheet "dup-rebates-mar". Columns: reseller_id, invoice_id, line_id, amount_delta, suggested_action.
Marta (Finance): Action items: @Dee fix pipeline + CSV, @Noah get partner ack, @Marta prepare memos. Marking P1 until payouts complete. :thumbsup:
